text_block_list.text:
After showing off her strength in the
Junior Cup,
Мэдзиро Райан is delighted to
have earned her
ticket to the place she's
dreamed of.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Immediately after, we hear excited
cheers from
the televised broadcast of
another race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin is on the screen, and she's just
won her
race in spectacular fashion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In the broadcast, Ines Fujin challenges
Mejiro
Ryan to be her rival at the Satsuki
Sho. Ryan
accepts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
